subject.title: feat(agents): add multi-pass context compaction with progress tracking

question: Should this PR merge internal multi-pass compaction groundwork now, or require production wiring/narrowing before this behavior remains in core?
rationale: The PR adds an uncalled compaction architecture path and public type fields around session-state-sensitive behavior; automation can identify the mismatch but cannot choose the permanent core compaction direction.

options.title: Require wiring or narrowing
options.body: Ask for a rebase plus either production wiring across the compaction callers or removal of the inert multi-pass/public type surface before merge.

options.title: Accept internal groundwork
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally accept the unused helper and public type drift as staged architecture work, but should own the compatibility and session-state risk explicitly.

options.title: Pause for architecture issue
options.body: Pause or close this PR in favor of the broader compaction architecture discussion if maintainers want a single coordinated design first.

recommendation.title: Require wiring or narrowing
recommendation.body: Ask for a rebase plus either production wiring across the compaction callers or removal of the inert multi-pass/public type surface before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom is the live assignee on this PR and is therefore the best available decision owner in the provided evidence.
